cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Let Me Lean
cards.instruction: Get someone to carry part of the emotional burden without making you name how heavy it has become.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Read the first line of this letter before I do. Slowly. You always rushed when I was teaching you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only if you can keep your face ordinary. You're better at that now. Mine won't be much help.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll sit beside you. We can take one line at a time.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Keep your finger under the words, like we used to. I'll follow it. Don't move on until I have.
